## Map

```{r}
#| include: false
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(measurements)
library(gfwr)      # >= 3.0 (gfw_ais_fishing_hours); token in .Renviron as GFW_TOKEN
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)

coord <- data.frame(site = c("Unimpacted", "Dredged"),
                    latitude = c("48 17.234", "48 19.156"),
                    longitude = c("-4 21.179", "-4 23.051")) |> 
  mutate(latitude = as.numeric(conv_unit(latitude, from = "deg_dec_min", to = "dec_deg")),
         longitude = as.numeric(conv_unit(longitude, from = "deg_dec_min", to = "dec_deg"))) |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) |> 
  st_transform(crs = 2154)

#zone d'etude : polygone WGS84 pour la requete GFW, bbox Lambert-93 pour le reste
crop_poly <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -4.6, xmax = -4.2, ymin = 48.249, ymax = 48.4),
                     crs = st_crs(4326)) |>
  st_as_sfc() |>
  st_sf()

crop_box <- crop_poly |> 
  st_transform(crs = 2154) |> 
  st_bbox()

#polygone bretagne
brit2 <- st_read("data/FRA_adm_shp/FRA_adm0.shp") |> 
  st_transform(crs = 2154) |> 
  st_crop(crop_box)

#donnee brute ofb : bancs de maerl confirmes
ofb_data <- read_sf("data/export_maj-4/maj.shp") |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(crs = 2154) |> 
  st_crop(crop_box) |> 
  select(geometry)

#donnee ifremer : sediment avec maerl
ofb_data2 <- read_sf("data/export_maj-4/IFR_RBT_MAERL_BZH_P.shp") |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(crs = 2154) |>  
  st_crop(crop_box) |>
  select(geometry)

#donnees GFW : effort de peche apparent, 0.01 deg, horaire
#l'API limite chaque requete a 366 jours -> deux requetes (end_date exclue)
periods <- list(c("2020-10-01", "2021-10-01"),
                c("2021-10-01", "2021-10-28"))

gfw_raw <- periods |> 
  lapply(\(p) gfw_ais_fishing_hours(spatial_resolution = "HIGH",
                                    temporal_resolution = "HOURLY",
                                    group_by = "GEARTYPE",
                                    start_date = p[1],
                                    end_date = p[2],
                                    region = crop_poly,
                                    region_source = "USER_SHAPEFILE") |> 
        mutate(across(everything(), as.character))) |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  mutate(across(c(Lat, Lon, `Vessel IDs`, `Apparent Fishing Hours`), as.numeric))
#somme des heures de peche par cellule sur toute la periode
#Lat/Lon GFW = coin inferieur gauche de la cellule -> +0.005 pour le centre
#(verifier avec head(gfw_raw) : des valeurs a 2 decimales indiquent des coins)
gfw_sum <- gfw_raw |> 
  # filter(geartype == "dredge_fishing") |>   #pour ne garder que les dragueurs
  group_by(Lon, Lat) |> 
  summarise(fishing_hours = sum(`Apparent Fishing Hours`), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(Lon = Lon + 0.005,
         Lat = Lat + 0.005)

#raster terra
fishing_r <- gfw_sum |> 
  select(Lon, Lat, fishing_hours) |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  rast(type = "xyz", crs = "EPSG:4326", digits = 6)

grid_full <- rast(xmin = -4.6, xmax = -4.2, ymin = 48.24, ymax = 48.40,
                  res = 0.01, crs = "EPSG:4326")

fishing_r <- fishing_r |> 
  extend(grid_full) |> 
  crop(grid_full) |> 
  subst(NA, 0)

#decoupage du raster selon les polygones des deux couches
maerl_v <- rbind(ofb_data, ofb_data2) |> 
  st_transform(crs = 4326) |> 
  vect()

maerl_union <- rbind(ofb_data, ofb_data2) |> 
  st_union()

inv_mask <- crop_box |> 
  st_as_sfc() |> 
  st_difference(maerl_union)

fishing_maerl <- fishing_r |> 
  crop(maerl_v, snap = "out") |> 
  mask(maerl_v, touches = TRUE)

(p_fishing <- ggplot() +
    geom_spatraster(data = fishing_maerl, alpha = .8) +
    scale_fill_gradient(name = "Fishing hours",
                        low = "#5F8FB8", high = "#C45C7A",
                        transform = "log1p",
                        na.value = "transparent") +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_sf(data = inv_mask, fill = "white", col = "transparent") +
    geom_sf(data = brit2, fill = "gray90", col = "transparent") +
    geom_sf(data = coord, aes(fill = site, shape = site), colour = "white", size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = c("#C45C7A", "#5F8FB8")) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = c(21, 24))  +
    coord_sf(crs = 2154,
             xlim = crop_box[c("xmin", "xmax")],
             ylim = crop_box[c("ymin", "ymax")],
             expand = FALSE,
             label_axes = list(top = "E", left = "N")) +
    scale_fill_gradient(name = "Fishing hours",
                        low = "#5F8FB8", high = "#C45C7A",
                        transform = "log1p",
                        na.value = "transparent") +
    scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = c(21, 24)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = c("#C45C7A", "#5F8FB8")) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "", breaks = c(-4.6, -4.4, -4.2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "", breaks = c(48.4, 48.3, 48.2)) +
    ggspatial::annotation_scale(width_hint = .2, style = "ticks") +
    ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(height = unit(1, "cm"), width = unit(1, "cm"),
                                      which_north = "true", location = "bl", 
                                      pad_x = unit(0.4, "in"), pad_y = unit(0.5, "in")) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      text = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
      legend.background = element_blank()
    ))
```

```{r}
    "Entomoneis sp." ~ "Entomoneis sp.1",

    "Amphora sp." ~ "Amphora sp.1",
```

## Taxonomic div

```{r}
worms_id <- function(fauna_homo) {
  species_name <- unique(fauna_homo$sp)

  # Transform taxa's names so that worms can find it
  species_name <- str_replace(species_name, " sp\\.1","")
  species_name <- str_replace(species_name, " sp\\.2","")
  species_name <- str_replace(species_name, " sp\\.","")
  species_name <- str_replace(species_name, " spp\\.","")
  species_name <- str_replace(species_name, " cf\\. "," ")


  # We check the names in worms using the taxize package. Check option accepted = TRUE for only accepted scientific names, and ask = TRUE for when ambiguities are found.

  worms_id <- taxize::get_wormsid(species_name, searchtype = "scientific", accepted=FALSE, ask= TRUE,verbose=TRUE, marine_only = FALSE)

  # Let's save the ID's with the species' names
  species_id <- data.frame(species=species_name,worms_id=as.numeric(worms_id)) %>%
    mutate(worms_id = ifelse(species == "Grania", 137349, worms_id))
  species_id
}

worms_classif <- function(species_id, fauna) {
  class(species_id$worms_id) <- "wormsid"


  # Classification extraction
  classif <- taxize::classification(species_id$worms_id)

  # Transform it from list to dataframe
  classif <- as.list(classif)

  tmp <- plyr::ldply(classif, dplyr::as_tibble)

  tmp <- tmp %>% select(1:3)

  colnames(tmp) <- c("worms_id","name","rank")


  # Spread the dataframe to have the different taxonomic levels as columns
  tmp <- reshape(tmp,idvar = "worms_id",v.names="name",timevar="rank",direction="wide")
  names(tmp) <- stringr::str_replace(names(tmp),"name.","")

  # Check for duplicated IDs in order to find possible identification problems
  plyr::ldply(classif, dplyr::as_tibble) %>% group_by(rank) %>% filter(duplicated(.id,rank)) %>% as.data.frame

  # Merge it with our species list
  class(species_id$worms_id) <- "character"

  sp_classif <- tmp %>%
    # Taxonomic level selection
    select(worms_id, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species) %>%
    # merge with our species list
    full_join(species_id,.,by="worms_id") %>%
    mutate(species_init=unique(fauna$sp)) %>%
    # Get the original names
    mutate_if(is.character,as.factor)

  # Check for duplicates
  print(sp_classif %>% filter(duplicated(worms_id)))

  # Vérification des taxons pour lesquels on a pas de nom d'espèces associé dans WORMS
  print(sp_classif %>% filter(is.na(Species)) %>% arrange(species_init) %>% distinct(species_init))

  sp_classif <- sp_classif %>%
    select(worms_id:species_init)
  sp_classif
}


taxo <- mpbc_homo %>% 
  mutate(scientificName = ifelse(str_detect(sp, "sp"),
                                 str_split_i(string = sp, pattern = " ", i = 1),
                                 sp),
         scientificName = str_remove(scientificName, "cf. "),
         genus = str_split_i(string = scientificName, pattern = " ", i = 1))
# test <- worms_id(taxo)
# save(test, file =  "worms_id.RData")
load("worms_id.RData")
test_classif <- worms_classif(test, taxo)
length(unique(test_classif$Family[!is.na(test_classif$Family)]))
length(unique(test_classif$Genus[!is.na(test_classif$Genus)]))
length(unique(test_classif$Order[!is.na(test_classif$Order)]))

data <- mpbc_homo %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sp, names_to = "code", values_to = "n") %>%
  left_join(test_classif, by = join_by(sp == species_init)) %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         site = as.factor(case_when(site== "L" ~ "Unimpacted",
                           site == "R" ~ "Dredged")),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = as.factor(case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn")),
         month = as.factor(month),
         date = clock::date_month_factor(as.Date(str_sub(code,2, -1), "%d_%m_%y")),
         date2 = as.factor(date)) %>% 
  filter(n > 0)

try <- data %>% 
         group_by(site, Order, Family, date) %>%
         summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
         ungroup() %>% 
         group_by(site, date) %>%
         mutate(tot = sum(n, na.rm=T)) %>%
         ungroup() %>%
  group_by(site, date, Order) %>% 
  mutate(relab = sum(n, na.rm=T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(relab = relab/tot) |> 
  group_by(Order) |> 
  mutate(relab_max = max(relab),
    Order = ifelse(relab_max < .1, "Other",
                   paste(Order)),
    Order = factor(Order, levels = c("Other", "Achnanthales", "Thalassiophysales", "Toxariales", "Fragilariales", "Paraliales", "Licmophorales", "Naviculales", "Bacillariales")),
    Family = ifelse(Order == "Other", "Other", paste(Family))
                ) |> 
  group_by(site, date, Order, Family) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n))

try <- data %>% 
  # Aggregate counts by site, month, order and family
  group_by(site, date, Order, Family) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  
  # Calculate total abundance per site × month
  group_by(site, date) %>%
  mutate(tot = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Calculate abundance of each order within each site × month
  group_by(site, date, Order) %>%
  mutate(
    order_n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    relab = order_n / tot
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Reclassify orders below 10% ASSEMBLY-WIDE within each sample
  mutate(
    Order = ifelse(relab < 0.1, "Other", as.character(Order)),
    Order = factor(
      Order,
      levels = c(
        "Other",
        "Achnanthales",
        "Thalassiophysales",
        "Toxariales",
        "Fragilariales",
        "Paraliales",
        "Licmophorales",
        "Naviculales",
        "Bacillariales"
      )
    ),
    Family = ifelse(Order == "Other", "Other", paste(Family))
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, date, Order, Family) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

)
```

### CWM

```{r}
#| include: false
# Recode the matrix to give the same weights to all traits 
#----------------------------------------------------------

# Create the function to convert the fuzzy coded matrix (going from 0 to 4 for each modality) to a relative coding in which all modality of a given trait sum to 1 for each species
transfo_traits <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(sum(x))) { # If we have NA's, gives back NA's
    rep(NA, length(x))
  } else if (sum(x) == 0) { #  If we have only 0's, gives back only 0's
    numeric(length(x))
  } else { # Else, we get the modality's score and divide it by the sum of the scores of the species for all modalities of this trait
    x / sum(x)
  }
}

all_fuzzy <- traits %>% 
  mutate(bv_5 = as.integer(if_else(bv < 3000, 4, 0)),
         bv_5_10 = as.integer(if_else(bv < 15000 & bv >= 3000, 4, 0)),
         bv_10_20 = as.integer(if_else(bv >= 15000, 4, 0))) %>%
  select(-bv)

trait_list <- data.frame(modality= colnames(all_fuzzy)) %>% 
  mutate(trait = c(
    rep("shape", 7), #shape
    rep("living habit", 5), #living habit
    rep("sociability", 6), #sociability
    rep("raphe", 3), #raphe
    rep("attachment", 4),
    rep("biovolume", 3)#attachment
  ))
  

# Prepare the trait list to apply the function
trait_list <- trait_list %>%
  # Reorder the list according to the order of the modalities in trait_fuz
  slice(match(colnames(all_fuzzy), trait_list$modality)) %>%
  # Reorder the trait factor levels
  mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels=unique(trait))) %>%
  droplevels()

# Compute the number of traits
n_trait <- nlevels(trait_list$trait)

# Define the start and end point of each trait
n_mod <- trait_list %>%
  # For that we compute the number of modalities for each trait
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  pull(n) %>%
  # And we do the cumulative sum
  cumsum(.) %>%
  c(0,.)

# Apply the function
trait_prop <- all_fuzzy 
fuzzy_only <- all_fuzzy 
trait_prop[,] <- NA

for(i in 1:n_trait){
  # Select all the modalities of the trait i
  tmp <- fuzzy_only[,seq(from=n_mod[i]+1, to=n_mod[i+1], by=1)]
  # Apply the function to this trait
  tmp <- t(apply(tmp, 1, transfo_traits))
  tmp <- as.data.frame(tmp)
  # Save
  trait_prop[,seq(from=n_mod[i]+1, to=n_mod[i+1], by=1)] <- tmp
}



summary(trait_prop) %>%
  kableExtra::kable("html") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = F, position="left") %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(column = n_mod+1, border_right = TRUE, include_thead = TRUE)



# com_trait <- as.matrix(mpbc_m2) %*% as.matrix(trait_prop)


# Compute CWM (we need to tell functcomp that trait_prop should considered as numerical) 
CWM_tot <- FD::functcomp(x=trait_prop,
                         a=as.matrix(mpbc_m2),
                         bin.num=c("cylinder",
                                   "cymbelloid",
                                   "gomphonemoid",
                                   "prism.on.triangular.base",
                                   # "epipsammic",
                                   # "epilithic",
                                   "zigzag",
                                   "araphid",
                                   "biraphid",
                                   "monoraphid",
                                   "bv_5",
                                   "bv_5_10",
                                   "bv_10_20")) %>%
  # Ensure that all variables are considered as numerical
  mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(as.character(.x))))

# Compute the abundance matrix
com_trait_estim_CWM <- rowSums(mpbc_m2,na.rm = TRUE) * CWM_tot
rownames(com_trait_estim_CWM) <- rownames(mpbc_m2)

# Check that the sum of abundances for each trait is equal to the total abundance of the sites

trait_list <- data.frame(modality= colnames(all_fuzzy)) %>% 
  mutate(trait = c(
    rep("shape", 7), #shape
    rep("living habit", 5), #living habit
    rep("sociability", 6), #sociability
    rep("raphe", 3), #raphe
    rep("attachment", 4),
    rep("biovolume", 3)#attachment
  ))

check_CWM <- com_trait_estim_CWM %>%
  rownames_to_column("id") %>%
  tidyr::gather(modality, value,-id) %>%
  left_join(., trait_list) %>%
  group_by(id,trait) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value,na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(., data.frame(id=rownames(mpbc_m2),tot=rowSums(mpbc_m2))) %>%
  mutate(match_init = near(value,tot, tol = 1e-5))

all(check_CWM$match_init)

cwmlong <- CWM_tot |> 
        rownames_to_column("code") |> 
        mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         site = as.factor(case_when(site== "L" ~ "Unimpacted",
                           site == "R" ~ "Dredged")),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         month = as.factor(month),
         date = as.Date(str_sub(code,2, -1), "%d_%m_%y")) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = bv_10_20:cylinder,
               names_to = "modality",
               values_to = "CWM") |> 
  mutate(Category = case_match(modality,
                                                          "bv_5" ~ "\u003C3000 \u00B5m\u00B3",
                                                          "bv_5_10" ~ "3000–15000 \u00B5m\u00B3",
                                                          "bv_10_20" ~ "\u003E15000 \u00B5m\u00B3",
                                                          .default = modality)) |> 
  left_join(trait_list) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

plots <- list()

for (i in levels(cwmlong$trait)) {
  
  plots[[i]] <- ggplot(cwmlong |> filter(trait == i)) +
    geom_bar(
      aes(x = month, y = CWM, fill = Category),
      position = "fill",
      stat = "identity"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = i,
      x = "Month",
      y = "CWM"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(facets = ~site)+
    scale_fill_viridis_d()+
    theme_light()+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.key.size = unit(.5, "cm"),
          legend.spacing =  unit(.1, "cm"),
          legend.text=element_text(size=8),
          legend.title = element_text(size=8),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 8))+
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
}
```

#RAC

```{r}
n_months <- data %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(date)) %>%
  pull(n)

abund_occ <- data %>%
  group_by(site, sp) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    occurrence = sum(n > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    occurrence = occurrence / n_months * 100
  )

site_presence <- data |> 
  group_by(site, sp) %>%
  summarise(
    present = any(n > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = site,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    distribution = case_when(
      Unimpacted & Dredged ~ "Both",
      Unimpacted & !Dredged ~ "Unimpacted only",
      !Unimpacted & Dredged ~ "Dredged only"
    )
  ) |> 
  left_join(traits |> rownames_to_column("sp") |>  select(sp, bv))


abund_occ <- abund_occ %>%
  left_join(
    site_presence %>%
      select(sp, distribution, bv),
    by = "sp"
  )
abund_occ <- abund_occ %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    abundance_rank = rank(-abundance, ties.method = "first"),
    occurrence_rank = rank(-occurrence, ties.method = "first")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

abundance_threshold <- median(abund_occ$abundance, na.rm = TRUE)

thresholds <- abund_occ %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = quantile(abundance)[2],
    q3 = quantile(abundance)[4],
    .groups = "drop"
  )


labels <- abund_occ %>%
  filter(
    abundance_rank <= 5 |
    occurrence_rank <= 5 |
    distribution == "Dredged only"
  )

strip_cols <- ggh4x::strip_themed(
  background_x = ggh4x::elem_list_rect(fill = c("#C45C7A", "#5F8FB8")),
  text_x       = ggh4x::elem_list_text(colour = c("white", "white"),
                                face = "bold")
)

p_occ <- ggplot(
  abund_occ
) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 50,
               linetype = 2) + 
  geom_hline(
  data = thresholds,
  aes(yintercept = median),
  linetype = 2)+
  geom_point(
    aes(
    x = occurrence,
    y = abundance,
    colour = distribution,
    size = bv
    ), 
    alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = labels,
    aes(x = occurrence,
        y = abundance,
        label = sp,
        colour = distribution),
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  ggh4x::facet_wrap2(~ site, strip = strip_cols) +
  labs(
    x = "Temporal occupancy (months)",
    y = "Total abundance (cells)",
    size = "Cell volume"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(breaks = c(3000, 15000, 30000))+
  theme_light()+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,100))+
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text=element_text(size=11))+
    scale_colour_manual(values = rev(c("#5F8FB8","#C45C7A", "gray45")))+
  guides(color = "none", size = "none")


fig2 <-  p_inext/p_occ+ plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2))
ggsave(filename = "fig_alpha.svg", plot = fig2, device = svglite::svglite, width = 210, height = 210, units = "mm", dpi = 300)

```

## Temporal diversity

### Biomass

```{r}
#| include: false
bv <- traits %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sp") %>% 
  mutate(c_pg = 10^(.76*log10(bv)-.352),
         c_mdl = .288*(bv^.811),
         diff = abs(c_pg-c_mdl)) %>% 
  arrange(sp) %>% 
  select(sp, bv, c_pg, c_mdl, diff)
mean(bv$diff)
sd(bv$diff)
mpbc_homo[is.na(mpbc_homo)] <- 0

surf <- (pi*(2.7^2))*10^-4 #m2
vtot <- 0.1 #Litres
vsub <- 0.003 #Litres
mpbb_m2 <- mpbc_homo %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = -sp, .fns = ~ .x * (vtot/vsub) * 1/surf))

mpbb <- mpbb_m2 %>% 
  left_join(bv |> select(-diff)) %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = R18_02_2021:L27_10_2021, .fns = ~ .x * c_pg * 1e-6)) %>% 
  select(-c_pg, -bv, -c_mdl) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sp") %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

mpbb_mdl <- mpbb_m2 %>% 
  left_join(bv |> select(-diff)) %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = R18_02_2021:L27_10_2021, .fns = ~ .x * c_mdl * 1e-6)) %>% 
  select(-c_pg, -c_mdl, -bv) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sp") %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

btot <- data.frame(code = rownames(mpbb), biomass =rowSums(mpbb), dens = rowSums(mpbc_m2)) %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         site = as.factor(case_when(site== "L" ~ "Unimpacted",
                           site == "R" ~ "Dredged")),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = as.factor(case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn")),
         month = as.factor(month),
         date = as.Date(str_sub(code,2, -1), "%d_%m_%y"),
         date2 = as.factor(date)) %>%
  left_join(pfdsite)

(pb <- ggplot(btot)+
  geom_line(aes(x = date,
                y = biomass*1e-3,
                colour = site,
                group = site),
            linewidth = 1)+
  scale_y_log10()+
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b",
               breaks = btot$date)+
  theme_light()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 11),
          # aspect.ratio = .5,
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none"
    )+
      scale_colour_manual(values = c("#C45C7A", "#5F8FB8"))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#C45C7A", "#5F8FB8"))+
  labs(y = expression(paste("Biomass (mg C ", m^-2, ")")),
         x = "Date")+
  coord_cartesian(expand = c(left =FALSE,
                             right = FALSE)))

btot2 <- data.frame(code = rownames(mpbb_mdl), biomass =rowSums(mpbb_mdl), dens = rowSums(mpbc_m2)) %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         site = as.factor(case_when(site== "L" ~ "Unimpacted",
                           site == "R" ~ "Dredged")),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = as.factor(case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn")),
         month = as.factor(month),
         date = as.Date(str_sub(code,2, -1), "%d_%m_%y"),
         date2 = as.factor(date)) %>%
  left_join(pfdsite)

bseg <- btot2 %>%
  mutate(dredging = case_when(month %in% c(2, 3, 10) & site == "Dredged" ~ "yes",
         .default = "no")) |> 
  arrange(site, date) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(date_end    = lead(date),
         biomass_end = lead(biomass),
         dredging_seg = lead(dredging)) %>%   # status of the interval ending at the next date
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(date_end))

(pb2 <- ggplot(bseg) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = date, xend = date_end,
                   y = biomass * 1e-3, yend = biomass_end * 1e-3,
                   colour = site,
                   linetype = dredging_seg),
               linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b",
               breaks = btot2$date) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#C45C7A", "#5F8FB8")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("no" = "solid", "yes" = "22"),
                        name = "Dredging") +
  theme_light() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 11),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(y = expression(paste("Biomass (mg C ", m^-2, ")")),
       x = "Date") +
  coord_cartesian(expand = c(left = FALSE, right = FALSE)))
btot2 |> group_by(site) |> summarise(avg = mean(biomass*1e-3),
                                     sd = sd(biomass*1e-3), 
                                     total = sum(biomass*1e-3),
                                     max = max(biomass*1e-3))

btot |> group_by(site) |> summarise(biomass = mean(biomass)*1e-3)
```

### Functional temporal diversity

```{r}
#| include: false
CWM_pcoa <- pcoa(dist.ldc(CWM_tot, "hellinger"), correction="none", rn=NULL)
# Calculate weighted average scores using the species data and PCoA result
weighted_scores <- wascores(CWM_pcoa$vectors, CWM_tot)

# Extract the scores for PCoA1 and PCoA2 dimensions
weighted_scores_pcoa <- data.frame(Dim1 =  weighted_scores[,1],
                                   Dim2 =  weighted_scores[,2])

# Select the top contributing species (e.g., top 10)
(top_species <- rownames(weighted_scores_pcoa)[order(weighted_scores_pcoa$Dim1, decreasing = TRUE)][1:9])

meta <- as.data.frame(CWM_tot) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         site = as.factor(ifelse(site == "R","Dredged", "Unimpacted")),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn"),
         date = as.Date(str_sub(code,2, -1), "%d_%m_%y")) %>% 
  select(site, month, season,code, date)

trajt <- defineTrajectories(dist.ldc(CWM_tot, "euclidean"), sites =meta$site, times = meta$month)
trajtobj <- trajectoryPCoA(trajt,  traj.colors = c("red", "blue"), lwd = 2, 
                      survey.labels = F)
legend("bottomleft", col = c("red", "blue"), legend=levels(meta$site), bty="n", lty=1, lwd = 2)


trajtdf <- trajtobj$points %>% as.data.frame()%>%
  bind_cols(meta) |> 
  mutate(dredging = case_when(month %in% c(2, 3, 10) & site == "Dredged" ~ "yes",
         .default = "no"))

trajectoryCorrespondence(trajt, verbose = TRUE)
trajectoryConvergence(trajt, type = "pairwise.symmetric")
trajectoryLengths(trajt)
trajectoryLengths(trajt, relativeToInitial = T)
trajectoryDistances(trajt)
trajectoryDirectionality(trajt)


```

```{r}
#| include: false
var_axes <- round(CWM_pcoa$values$Eigenvalues[CWM_pcoa$values$Eigenvalues >0]/sum(CWM_pcoa$values$Eigenvalues[CWM_pcoa$values$Eigenvalues > 0])*100,2)

trajtseg <- trajtdf %>%
  arrange(site, month) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(xend = lead(V1),
         yend = lead(V2),
         dredging_seg = lead(dredging)) %>%   # status of the interval ending at the next survey
  filter(!is.na(xend)) |> 
   mutate(is_last = row_number() == n()) |>
  ungroup()
arrowseg <- trajtseg %>%
  filter(is_last) %>%
  mutate(xstart = xend - 0.02 * (xend - V1),
         ystart = yend - 0.02 * (yend - V2))
arrowseg_Unimpacted <- filter(arrowseg, site == "Unimpacted")
arrowseg_dredged  <- filter(arrowseg, site == "Dredged")

t1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = trajtdf |> filter(month != 10),
             aes(x = V1, y = V2, colour = site, shape = dredging),
             size = 1.25) +
  geom_segment(data = trajtseg,
               aes(x = V1, y = V2, xend = xend, yend = yend,
                   colour = site, linetype = dredging_seg),
               linewidth = 1) +
  # closed arrowhead, Unimpacted site
  geom_segment(data = arrowseg_Unimpacted,
               aes(x = xstart, y = ystart, xend = xend, yend = yend,
                   colour = site),
               linewidth = 1,
               linetype = "solid",
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
  # open arrowhead, dredged site
  geom_segment(data = arrowseg_dredged,
               aes(x = xstart, y = ystart, xend = xend, yend = yend,
                   colour = site),
               linewidth = 1,
               linetype = "solid",
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "open")) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#C45C7A", "#5F8FB8")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("no" = "solid", "yes" = "22"),
                        name = "Dredging") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("no" = 16, "yes" = 1),
                     name = "Dredging") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-.75, 1.25), ylim = c(-.75, 1.25), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(.9,.9),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.box.background = element_blank(),
        legend.frame = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = paste("Dim 1:", var_axes[1], "%"),
       y = paste("Dim 2:", var_axes[2], "%"),
       color = "Site")+
  guides(linetype = "none",
         shape = "none")
```

### Taxonomic temporal diversity

```{r}
#| output: false
mpbc_pcoa <- pcoa(dist.ldc(mpbc, "hellinger"), correction="none", rn=NULL)
# Calculate weighted average scores using the species data and PCoA result
weighted_scores <- wascores(mpbc_pcoa$vectors, mpbc)

# Extract the scores for PCoA1 and PCoA2 dimensions
weighted_scores_pcoa <- data.frame(Dim1 =  weighted_scores[,1],
                                   Dim2 =  weighted_scores[,2])


# Select the top contributing species (e.g., top 10)
(top_species <- rownames(weighted_scores_pcoa)[order(weighted_scores_pcoa$Dim1, decreasing = TRUE)][1:9])

meta <- as.data.frame(mpbc) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         site = as.factor(ifelse(site == "R","Dredged", "Unimpacted")),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn"),
         code = paste(site,season)) %>% 
  select(site, month, season,code)

traj <- defineTrajectories(dist.ldc(mpbc, "hellinger"), sites =meta$site, times = meta$month)
trajobj <- trajectoryPCoA(traj,  traj.colors = c("red", "blue"), lwd = 2, 
                      survey.labels = F)
legend("bottomleft", col = c("red", "blue"), legend=levels(meta$site), bty="n", lty=1, lwd = 2)

trajectoryCorrespondence(traj)
trajectoryConvergence(traj, type = "pairwise.symmetric")
trajectoryLengths(traj)
trajectoryLengths(traj, relativeToInitial = T)
trajectoryDistances(traj)
trajectoryDirectionality(traj)
trajdf <- trajobj$points %>% as.data.frame()%>%
  bind_cols(meta) |> 
  mutate(dredging = case_when(month %in% c(2, 3, 10) & site == "Dredged" ~ "yes",
         .default = "no"))
```
